caveats.summary: DeepFilterNet controlled evidence covers one approved private bounded speech-cleanup sample only.
Signalsmith controlled evidence covers one approved private bounded timing/stretch sample only.
Demucs source separation is excluded from restricted internal scope and remains blocked pending training-data provenance and human/legal review.
FFmpeg/ffprobe were used only in bounded private runtime phases and still require production configuration/legal review.
Linux CPU Cloud Run jobs supplied prior bounded evidence; Phase 36M does not approve broad Cloud Run worker use.
VLM remains blocked and OCR runtime outside approved phases remains blocked; neither blocks audio/timing internal-scope evidence.
No broad user media, arbitrary media, public output, or final export path is approved.
